string-array.item: Request forms in places, commander gusts up to moderate.
Precipitation in the form of remarks.
Clearing possible: the battalion commander is in a good mood until lunch.
Mist, sunshine and sheep on the horizon.
Steadily cloudy over the meeting room.
Clear. Suspiciously clear.

string-array.name: w_vibes
string-array.item: You\'re home. Everything else is to be confirmed.
Today you don\'t have to prove anything. Not even with a certificate.
Vibe of the day: coffee, silence, zero formations.
Nobody expects a written report on your mood.
You don\'t have to be twice as good. Being is enough.
The cat at the warm bus stop believes in you.
Today\'s mission: the most beautiful cloud.
The cows are in place. So are you.
The queue can wait. You can\'t.
The meeting room is free. You can just sit there.
A good day to plan nothing.
MinVibeVet approves of sleeping until noon.
